items.title: File Einspruch against the 2025 Einkommensteuerbescheid
items.quote: Der Einspruch muss binnen eines Monats nach der Bekanntgabe beim Finanzamt Musterhöhe eingehen, schriftlich, über das Portal ELSTER oder mündlich zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: Letter is dated 19.11.2026 (Thursday); no separate 'Tag der Aufgabe zur Post' is stated, so the posting day equals the letter date, 19.11.2026. Per the current PostModG rule (letter posted on/after 1 Jan 2025), delivery is deemed on the 4th calendar day after posting: 19.11 + 4 days = 23.11.2026 (Monday). As this is a Finanzamt, if that 4th day were a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday it would move to the next working day (§108 Abs.3 AO); 23.11.2026 is a normal Monday in NW, so delivery is deemed on 23.11.2026. The one-month Einspruch period under §355 Abs.1 AO starts the day after deemed delivery (§187 Abs.1 BGB / §108 Abs.1 AO) and ends on the day in the following month bearing the same number as the delivery day: 23.12.2026 (Wednesday). That day is a normal working day in NW (not a holiday), so no further shift under §108 Abs.3 AO is needed. Final deadline: 23.12.2026.
